text: Not to extinguish our free will, I hold it to be true that Fortune is the arbiter of one-half of our actions, but that she still leaves us to direct the other half, or perhaps a little less.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXV, What fortune can effect in human affairs and how to withstand her
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
